svg.aria-label: Left: a laptop and a desktop PC, each running Claude Code and Codex sessions that look alike, some with subagents under them and three with a question left in the chat, and GitHub with two open pull requests. Right: one parawatch board with what needs you, the pull requests that wait on others, and every session by project with its subagents, its state, a timeline of the last hour and its machine.
